name: Draggable CAPTCHA
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction: 
 
 Extended the captcha module, offered a mobile friendly, draggable & clickable style. 
 Originally used a free lib from blog.lukeblackamore.com , which had been changed and improved a lot in this module. 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation: 
 
 Install as usual modules. 
 
 Back to top 

 Features: 
 
 Draggable and Clickable. 
 Refreshable. 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependency 
 
 captcha 
 GD library PNG support 
 GD library rotate and desaturate effects 
 
 Back to top 

 Known issues: 
 
 IE6 is not supported well, due to transparent png 
 This captcha isn't suite for high secure forms, it currently has a 1/(4*4) chance to guess a right answer with 4 buttons on 4 places. 
 [#1935788]
